When you are done, put your final answer between <answer> and </answer> tags.

message.content:
Using the standard integral

\[
\int \exp(x)\cos(x)\,dx = \frac{\exp(x)(\sin(x)+\cos(x))}{2} + C
\]

we get

\[
\int -3*\exp(x)*\cos(x)\,dx
= -3*\left(\frac{\exp(x)*(sin(x)+cos(x))}{2}\right)+C
\]

\[
= (-3/2)*\exp(x)*(sin(x)+cos(x))+C
\]

<answer>(-3/2)*exp(x)*(sin(x)+cos(x))+C</answer>
